mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deleted_student (student_id, scope, event_id, deleted_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{scope}, #{eventId}, #{deletedAt}) ON CONFLICT (student_id) DO UPDATE SET scope = CASE WHEN deleted_student.scope = 'PROFILE' THEN 'PROFILE' ELSE EXCLUDED.scope END, event_id = EXCLUDED.event_id, deleted_at = EXCLUDED.deleted_at
